## AsrSessionOptions.vadSilenceRms property

Silence threshold as RMS in normalized \[-1, 1\]. Audio chunks with RMS below this are treated as silence. Default 0.01 — typical room noise sits 0.001–0.005, normal speech sits 0.05–0.3. Bump higher in noisy environments; lower for quiet voices.

**Signature:**

```typescript
vadSilenceRms?: number;
```
